NOWRIFT / EDITABLE DESIGN SPECIFICATION

Rift Outfitters & Equipment

Five editable HTML/SVG boards using original pixel art, production shop offers, authoritative stat calculations and the same modular appearance resolver as the game. Figma MCP canvas tools are unavailable in this session; this is a local design specification, and no Figma file or URL was created.

A Merchant shopB EquipmentC CompareD InteractionE Art catalog
BOARD A / MERCHANT SHOP

Made for the road ahead.

Desktop: catalog → layered try-on → bonuses and purchase. Mobile: scrolling catalog → accessible full-screen detail sheet with a close control, trapped focus, scroll and a purchase action of at least 44px. The live game opens that sheet when a card is selected.

BOARD B / CHARACTER EQUIPMENT

Seven slots. One shared inventory.

helmet +0
weapon +0
armor +0
ring+0
pants +0
necklace+0
boots +0

Independent layers

The candidate changes only legwear. Chest armor, headwear, footwear, weapon, jewelry, skin, face and hair retain their own definitions. The preview carries a display-only copy of the item; confirming an equip writes the real owned instance through the existing command.

48px source frames. Pivot (24,36). All 104 animation frames and all three archetypes use synchronized modular atlases.

Interaction variants

Selected: gold inset edge. Empty: em dash and “Empty.” Equipped: icon, enhancement and protected sale action. Owned: equip, forge and eligible sell. Rarity color is secondary to collection silhouette.

Paperdoll slot buttons select the four merchant categories. Weapon, ring and necklace tiles retain their existing inventory behavior and ownership.

BOARD D / MERCHANT INTERACTION

Every action follows ownership.

01 Dialogue

Talia offers four categories. Map, sign and contextual interaction reuse the existing market landmark.

02 Select

Dunewalker Wraps · Rare · level 9. Only the preview changes.

03 Confirm purchase

324 Gold · Confirm / Cancel. The quoted offer, expected revision and unique receipt go through the existing transaction.

04 Purchase success

Purchase complete. Wallet 526 Gold. “Inspect owned copy” opens the new instance, then “Equip this item” applies it.

05 Not enough gold

Not enough gold. The buy action is disabled; command validation also rejects it.

06 Full inventory

Inventory full. Selling or freeing a bag slot restores eligibility.

07 Equip action

Equip recalculates saved stats and the live layered rig. Unequip removes bonuses. Forge opens the existing selected-item blacksmith.

08 Confirm sale

Eligible owned item → real sale quote → confirmation → committed inventory and gold. Equipped, favorite and locked items remain protected.

BOARD E / ORIGINAL PIXEL ART CATALOG

Four material identities.

Original editable SVG pixels at 32px. Enlarged 3× and native 1× views. Existing equipment IDs remain stable. Legwear and footwear use independently authored silhouettes for each biome; source generation emits synchronized 48px modular animation layers.

Forest: stitched leather, bark panels and green cloth.
Desert: bronze plates, wrapped woven fabric and gold edging.

Frozen: cold steel, pale fabric and cyan facets.
Infernal: volcanic plates, crimson cloth and ember seams.

Light from upper left. Controlled palette, transparent gutters and binary alpha. Nearest-neighbor rendering. Rarity shapes follow existing common/uncommon, rare, epic/legendary tiers.
